## About AIMLpartner
AIMLpartner (AIML Partner Inc.) is an elite sovereign AI engineering consultancy headquartered in New Jersey, USA. We architect, validate, and deploy bespoke autonomous AI agent pods directly inside private enterprise cloud perimeters (AWS, Azure, GCP VPCs) with 100% client IP custody.

Unlike traditional management consultancies that deliver static slide decks, AIMLpartner operates in rapid 14-day outcome sprints shipping production-grade sovereign AI systems.

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Phase 01 // Blueprint Architecture (14-Day Audit)
Comprehensive codebase and workflow audit identifying high-leverage AI opportunities, data architecture pipelines, and air-gapped security models.

### 2. Phase 02 // Autonomous Pod Assembly
Embedded engineering sprints assembling custom multi-agent graphs, private RAG pipelines, and deterministic integration connectors across enterprise systems (Salesforce, Snowflake, Jira, Postgres, Slack).

### 3. Phase 03 // Production Launch & Scale
Direct VPC deployment, real-time latency and accuracy telemetry, continuous fine-tuning, and zero vendor lock-in.
